description: One-row operational summary for available, claimable, cooling-down and owned pool items.
fromSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.crm_lpi_status = 'available') AS available_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.crm_lpi_status = 'available' AND (i.crm_lpi_claim_release_at IS NULL OR i.crm_lpi_claim_release_at <= now())) AS ready_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.crm_lpi_status = 'available' AND i.crm_lpi_claim_release_at > now()) AS cooldown_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.crm_lpi_status IN ('claimed', 'assigned')) AS owned_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.crm_lpi_status IN ('recycling', 'recycling_retry')) AS processing_count FROM mt_crm_lead_pool_item_common i JOIN mt_crm_lead_pool_common p ON p.pid = i.crm_lpi_pool_id AND p.tenant_id = i.tenant_id WHERE i.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND (p.crm_lp_member_user_ids LIKE CONCAT('%"', (SELECT pid FROM ab_user WHERE id = CAST(#{params.currentUserId} AS bigint)), '"%') OR p.crm_lp_admin_user_ids LIKE CONCAT('%"', (SELECT pid FROM ab_user WHERE id = CAST(#{params.currentUserId} AS bigint)), '"%'))

name:zh-CN: 线索池领取与分配队列
name:en: Lead Pool Claim and Assignment Queue
description: Dense task queue with policy context and explicit readiness for claim and assignment decisions.
fromSql: SELECT q.* FROM (SELECT i.pid, i.crm_lpi_lead_id, i.crm_lpi_pool_id, p.crm_lp_name AS pool_name, i.crm_lpi_status, i.crm_lpi_lead_code, i.crm_lpi_company, i.crm_lpi_contact_name, i.crm_lpi_contact_phone, i.crm_lpi_source, i.crm_lpi_score, i.crm_lpi_entered_at, i.crm_lpi_reason, i.crm_lpi_claim_release_at, i.crm_lpi_claimed_at, i.crm_lpi_claimed_by, COALESCE(owner_user.nick_name, owner_user.user_name, i.crm_lpi_claimed_by, '') AS owner_name, i.crm_lpi_previous_owner, COALESCE(previous_user.nick_name, previous_user.user_name, i.crm_lpi_previous_owner, '') AS previous_owner_name, CASE WHEN i.crm_lpi_status = 'available' AND (i.crm_lpi_claim_release_at IS NULL OR i.crm_lpi_claim_release_at <= now()) THEN 'ready' WHEN i.crm_lpi_status = 'available' THEN 'cooldown' ELSE i.crm_lpi_status END AS operational_state FROM mt_crm_lead_pool_item_common i JOIN mt_crm_lead_pool_common p ON p.pid = i.crm_lpi_pool_id AND p.tenant_id = i.tenant_id LEFT JOIN ab_user owner_user ON owner_user.pid = i.crm_lpi_claimed_by LEFT JOIN ab_user previous_user ON previous_user.pid = i.crm_lpi_previous_owner WHERE i.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND (p.crm_lp_member_user_ids LIKE CONCAT('%"', (SELECT pid FROM ab_user WHERE id = CAST(#{params.currentUserId} AS bigint)), '"%') OR p.crm_lp_admin_user_ids LIKE CONCAT('%"', (SELECT pid FROM ab_user WHERE id = CAST(#{params.currentUserId} AS bigint)), '"%'))) q WHERE (COALESCE(CAST(#{params.leadKeyword} AS text), '') = '' OR q.crm_lpi_lead_code ILIKE CONCAT('%', CAST(#{params.leadKeyword} AS text), '%') OR q.crm_lpi_company ILIKE CONCAT('%', CAST(#{params.leadKeyword} AS text), '%') OR q.crm_lpi_contact_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', CAST(#{params.leadKeyword} AS text), '%')) AND (COALESCE(CAST(#{params.viewFilter} AS text), '') = '' OR (CAST(#{params.viewFilter} AS text) = 'available' AND q.crm_lpi_status = 'available') OR (CAST(#{params.viewFilter} AS text) = 'ready' AND q.operational_state = 'ready') OR (CAST(#{params.viewFilter} AS text) = 'cooldown' AND q.operational_state = 'cooldown') OR (CAST(#{params.viewFilter} AS text) = 'owned' AND q.crm_lpi_status IN ('claimed', 'assigned')) OR (CAST(#{params.viewFilter} AS text) = 'processing' AND q.crm_lpi_status IN ('recycling', 'recycling_retry'))) ORDER BY CASE q.operational_state WHEN 'ready' THEN 1 WHEN 'cooldown' THEN 2 WHEN 'recycling_retry' THEN 3 WHEN 'recycling' THEN 4 WHEN 'assigned' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END, q.crm_lpi_score DESC NULLS LAST, q.crm_lpi_entered_at ASC

description: Get all activities related to a specific CRM object via association graph
fromSql: SELECT a.*, a.crm_act_ext->>'status' AS crm_act_status, a.crm_act_ext->>'priority' AS crm_act_priority, NULLIF(a.crm_act_ext->>'dueDate', '')::date AS crm_act_due_date, r.crm_ar_role, COALESCE(u.nick_name, u.user_name, '未分配') AS owner_name FROM mt_crm_activity_common a JOIN mt_crm_activity_relation_common r ON a.pid = r.crm_ar_activity_id AND r.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} LEFT JOIN ab_user u ON u.pid = a.crm_act_owner WHERE r.crm_ar_object_type = #{params.objectType} AND r.crm_ar_object_id = #{params.objectId} AND a.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} ORDER BY a.crm_act_date DESC

name:zh-CN: 按直接关联对象查任务
description: Get task activities directly anchored to a workspace object via crm_act_related_model and crm_act_related_id
fromSql: SELECT a.*, a.crm_act_ext->>'status' AS crm_act_status, a.crm_act_ext->>'priority' AS crm_act_priority, NULLIF(a.crm_act_ext->>'dueDate', '')::date AS crm_act_due_date, a.crm_act_ext->>'assignee' AS crm_act_assignee FROM mt_crm_activity_common a WHERE a.crm_act_related_model = #{params.relatedModel} AND a.crm_act_related_id = #{params.relatedId} AND a.crm_act_type = 'task' AND a.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} ORDER BY NULLIF(a.crm_act_ext->>'dueDate', '')::date ASC NULLS LAST, a.crm_act_date DESC

name:zh-CN: 按直接关联对象查时间线
description: Get all activities directly anchored to a workspace object via crm_act_related_model and crm_act_related_id
fromSql: SELECT a.*, a.crm_act_ext->>'status' AS crm_act_status, a.crm_act_ext->>'priority' AS crm_act_priority, NULLIF(a.crm_act_ext->>'dueDate', '')::date AS crm_act_due_date, a.crm_act_ext->>'assignee' AS crm_act_assignee FROM mt_crm_activity_common a WHERE a.crm_act_related_model = #{params.relatedModel} AND a.crm_act_related_id = #{params.relatedId} AND a.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} ORDER BY a.crm_act_date DESC

name:zh-CN: 按直接关联对象查任务评论
description: Get comment or note activities attached to task activities under one directly related workspace object
fromSql: SELECT c.pid, c.crm_act_type, c.crm_act_subject, c.crm_act_content, c.crm_act_date, c.crm_act_owner, c.crm_act_source, c.crm_act_parent_id, c.crm_act_files, c.crm_act_related_model, c.crm_act_related_id, p.crm_act_subject AS parent_task_subject, p.crm_act_ext->>'status' AS parent_task_status FROM mt_crm_activity_common c JOIN mt_crm_activity_common p ON p.pid = c.crm_act_parent_id AND p.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} WHERE p.crm_act_related_model = #{params.relatedModel} AND p.crm_act_related_id = #{params.relatedId} AND p.crm_act_type = 'task' AND c.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} ORDER BY c.crm_act_date DESC

description: Get all open tasks assigned to or owned by current user
fromSql: SELECT a.*, a.crm_act_ext->>'status' AS crm_act_status, a.crm_act_ext->>'priority' AS crm_act_priority, (a.crm_act_ext->>'dueDate')::date AS crm_act_due_date FROM mt_crm_activity_common a WHERE a.crm_act_type = 'task' AND (a.crm_act_ext->>'assignee' = #{params.currentUserId} OR a.crm_act_owner = #{params.currentUserId}) AND a.crm_act_ext->>'status' IN ('open', 'in_progress') AND a.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} ORDER BY (a.crm_act_ext->>'dueDate')::date ASC NULLS LAST

description: All activities related to an account (direct + via contacts + via opportunities)
fromSql: SELECT DISTINCT a.*, a.crm_act_ext->>'status' AS crm_act_status, a.crm_act_ext->>'priority' AS crm_act_priority, r.crm_ar_object_type, r.crm_ar_role, COALESCE(u.nick_name, u.user_name, '未分配') AS owner_name FROM mt_crm_activity_common a JOIN mt_crm_activity_relation_common r ON a.pid = r.crm_ar_activity_id AND r.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} LEFT JOIN ab_user u ON u.pid = a.crm_act_owner WHERE a.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND ((r.crm_ar_object_type = 'account' AND r.crm_ar_object_id = #{params.objectId}) OR (r.crm_ar_object_type = 'contact' AND r.crm_ar_object_id IN (SELECT pid FROM mt_crm_contact_common WHERE crm_ct_account_id = #{params.objectId} AND tenant_id = #{params.tenantId})) OR (r.crm_ar_object_type = 'opportunity' AND r.crm_ar_object_id IN (SELECT pid FROM mt_crm_opportunity_common WHERE crm_opp_account_id = #{params.objectId} AND tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}))) ORDER BY a.crm_act_date DESC

description: Lead counts grouped by status for pipeline overview
fromSql: SELECT crm_lead_status AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM mt_crm_lead_common WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} GROUP BY crm_lead_status ORDER BY count DESC

description: Opportunity counts and total amounts grouped by stage
fromSql: SELECT crm_opp_stage AS stage, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(crm_opp_expected_amount::numeric), 0) AS total_amount FROM mt_crm_opportunity_common WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} GROUP BY crm_opp_stage ORDER BY CASE crm_opp_stage WHEN 'prospecting' THEN 1 WHEN 'qualification' THEN 2 WHEN 'proposal' THEN 3 WHEN 'negotiation' THEN 4 WHEN 'closed_won' THEN 5 WHEN 'closed_lost' THEN 6 ELSE 7 END

description: Overall CRM KPI: total leads, open opportunities, won revenue, active accounts, pending complaints, and pending quote summaries
fromSql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mt_crm_lead_common WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}) AS total_leads, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mt_crm_lead_common WHERE crm_lead_status = 'new' AND tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}) AS new_leads, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mt_crm_opportunity_common WHERE crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost') AND tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}) AS open_opportunities, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(crm_opp_expected_amount::numeric), 0) FROM mt_crm_opportunity_common WHERE crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost') AND tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}) AS pipeline_value, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(crm_opp_expected_amount::numeric), 0) FROM mt_crm_opportunity_common WHERE crm_opp_stage = 'closed_won' AND tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}) AS won_revenue, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mt_crm_account_common WHERE crm_acc_status = 'active' AND tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}) AS active_accounts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mt_crm_complaint WHERE crm_cmp_status IN ('open', 'investigating') AND tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}) AS pending_complaints, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mt_crm_quote_summary_common WHERE crm_qs_status IN ('draft', 'pricing', 'approval') AND tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}) AS pending_quotes

description: Recent CRM activities across all objects for dashboard
fromSql: SELECT a.pid, a.crm_act_type, a.crm_act_subject, a.crm_act_date, a.crm_act_owner, a.crm_act_source, COALESCE(r.crm_ar_object_type, CASE a.crm_act_related_model WHEN 'crm_account_common' THEN 'account' WHEN 'crm_contact_common' THEN 'contact' WHEN 'crm_lead_common' THEN 'lead' WHEN 'crm_opportunity_common' THEN 'opportunity' WHEN 'crm_quote_summary_common' THEN 'quote' WHEN 'crm_complaint' THEN 'complaint' ELSE NULL END) AS crm_ar_object_type FROM mt_crm_activity_common a LEFT JOIN mt_crm_activity_relation_common r ON a.pid = r.crm_ar_activity_id AND r.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} WHERE a.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} ORDER BY a.crm_act_date DESC LIMIT 20

description: Recent opportunities with business account names for the CRM dashboard.
fromSql: SELECT o.pid, o.crm_opp_name, COALESCE(a.crm_acc_name, '未关联客户') AS account_name, o.crm_opp_stage, o.crm_opp_expected_amount, o.created_at FROM mt_crm_opportunity_common o LEFT JOIN mt_crm_account_common a ON a.pid = o.crm_opp_account_id AND a.tenant_id = o.tenant_id WHERE o.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 50

description: Pending quote summaries with business account names for the CRM dashboard.
fromSql: SELECT q.pid, q.crm_qs_code, COALESCE(a.crm_acc_name, '未关联客户') AS account_name, q.crm_qs_source_quote_type, q.crm_qs_quote_amount, q.crm_qs_status, q.created_at FROM mt_crm_quote_summary_common q LEFT JOIN mt_crm_account_common a ON a.pid = q.crm_qs_account_id AND a.tenant_id = q.tenant_id WHERE q.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND q.crm_qs_status IN ('draft', 'pricing', 'approval') ORDER BY q.created_at DESC LIMIT 50

description: Fetch leads with activity counts for AI scoring. Supports unscoredOnly filter.
fromSql: SELECT l.pid, l.crm_lead_company AS company, l.crm_lead_contact_name AS contact_name, l.crm_lead_source AS source, l.crm_lead_industry AS industry, l.crm_lead_status AS status, l.crm_lead_requirement AS requirement, l.crm_lead_score AS current_score, COALESCE(act.activity_count, 0) AS activity_count, act.last_activity_date FROM mt_crm_lead_common l LEFT JOIN (SELECT r.crm_ar_object_id, COUNT(*) AS activity_count, MAX(a.crm_act_date) AS last_activity_date FROM mt_crm_activity_relation_common r JOIN mt_crm_activity_common a ON r.crm_ar_activity_id = a.pid AND a.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} WHERE r.crm_ar_object_type = 'lead' AND r.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} GROUP BY r.crm_ar_object_id) act ON l.pid = act.crm_ar_object_id WHERE l.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND (#{params.unscoredOnly} IS NULL OR #{params.unscoredOnly} = '' OR l.crm_lead_score IS NULL) ORDER BY l.created_at DESC

description: Fetch new leads whose latest related activity is older than the supplied staleBefore timestamp, or that have no related activity. Use leadKeyword to narrow company/contact names.
fromSql: SELECT l.pid, l.crm_lead_company AS company, l.crm_lead_contact_name AS contact_name, l.crm_lead_source AS source, l.crm_lead_industry AS industry, l.crm_lead_status AS status, COALESCE(act.activity_count, 0) AS activity_count, act.last_activity_date FROM mt_crm_lead_common l LEFT JOIN (SELECT r.crm_ar_object_id, COUNT(*) AS activity_count, MAX(a.crm_act_date) AS last_activity_date FROM mt_crm_activity_relation_common r JOIN mt_crm_activity_common a ON r.crm_ar_activity_id = a.pid AND a.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} WHERE r.crm_ar_object_type = 'lead' AND r.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} GROUP BY r.crm_ar_object_id) act ON l.pid = act.crm_ar_object_id WHERE l.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND l.crm_lead_status = 'new' AND (COALESCE(CAST(#{params.leadKeyword} AS text), '') = '' OR l.crm_lead_company ILIKE CONCAT('%', CAST(#{params.leadKeyword} AS text), '%') OR l.crm_lead_contact_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', CAST(#{params.leadKeyword} AS text), '%')) AND (act.last_activity_date IS NULL OR act.last_activity_date < CAST(#{params.staleBefore} AS timestamp)) ORDER BY act.last_activity_date ASC NULLS FIRST, l.created_at DESC

description: Aggregate statistics for a specific account: opportunity count, won amount, quote summary count, complaint count
fromSql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mt_crm_opportunity_common WHERE crm_opp_account_id = #{params.accountId} AND tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}) AS open_opportunities, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(crm_opp_expected_amount::numeric), 0) FROM mt_crm_opportunity_common WHERE crm_opp_account_id = #{params.accountId} AND crm_opp_stage = 'closed_won' AND tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}) AS won_revenue, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mt_crm_quote_summary_common WHERE crm_qs_account_id = #{params.accountId} AND tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}) AS total_quotes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mt_crm_complaint WHERE crm_cmp_account_id = #{params.accountId} AND tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}) AS total_complaints, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mt_crm_contact_common WHERE crm_ct_account_id = #{params.accountId} AND tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}) AS total_contacts

description: Lead count grouped by source for pie/bar chart
fromSql: SELECT crm_lead_source AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM mt_crm_lead_common WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND crm_lead_source IS NOT NULL GROUP BY crm_lead_source ORDER BY value DESC

description: Opportunity creation trend over last 6 months with count and total amount
fromSql: SELECT TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(crm_opp_expected_amount::numeric), 0) AS total_amount FROM mt_crm_opportunity_common WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '6 months' GROUP BY TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY month ASC

description: Win vs Loss counts for closed opportunities
fromSql: SELECT crm_opp_stage AS stage, COUNT(*) AS count FROM mt_crm_opportunity_common WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND crm_opp_stage IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost') GROUP BY crm_opp_stage

description: Pipeline forecast: opportunity count, total amount, and weighted forecast grouped by stage
fromSql: SELECT crm_opp_stage AS stage, COUNT(*) AS opportunity_count, COALESCE(SUM(crm_opp_expected_amount), 0) AS total_amount, COALESCE(AVG(crm_opp_probability), 0) AS avg_probability, COALESCE(SUM(crm_opp_expected_amount * COALESCE(crm_opp_probability, CASE crm_opp_stage WHEN 'discovery' THEN 10 WHEN 'qualification' THEN 25 WHEN 'proposal' THEN 50 WHEN 'negotiation' THEN 75 ELSE 10 END) / 100), 0) AS weighted_forecast FROM mt_crm_opportunity_common WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost') GROUP BY crm_opp_stage ORDER BY CASE crm_opp_stage WHEN 'discovery' THEN 1 WHEN 'qualification' THEN 2 WHEN 'proposal' THEN 3 WHEN 'negotiation' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

description: Pipeline forecast grouped by expected close month for timeline visualization
fromSql: SELECT TO_CHAR(crm_opp_expected_close_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(*) AS opportunity_count, COALESCE(SUM(crm_opp_expected_amount), 0) AS total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(crm_opp_expected_amount * COALESCE(crm_opp_probability, CASE crm_opp_stage WHEN 'discovery' THEN 10 WHEN 'qualification' THEN 25 WHEN 'proposal' THEN 50 WHEN 'negotiation' THEN 75 ELSE 10 END) / 100), 0) AS weighted_forecast FROM mt_crm_opportunity_common WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost') AND crm_opp_expected_close_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY TO_CHAR(crm_opp_expected_close_date, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY month

description: Pipeline forecast grouped by opportunity owner for team comparison
fromSql: SELECT u.pid AS owner_pid, COALESCE(u.nick_name, u.user_name, '未分配') AS owner_name, COUNT(*) AS opportunity_count, COALESCE(SUM(o.crm_opp_expected_amount), 0) AS total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(o.crm_opp_expected_amount * COALESCE(o.crm_opp_probability, CASE o.crm_opp_stage WHEN 'discovery' THEN 10 WHEN 'qualification' THEN 25 WHEN 'proposal' THEN 50 WHEN 'negotiation' THEN 75 ELSE 10 END) / 100), 0) AS weighted_forecast FROM mt_crm_opportunity_common o LEFT JOIN ab_user u ON o.crm_opp_owner = u.pid WHERE o.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND o.crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost') GROUP BY u.pid, COALESCE(u.nick_name, u.user_name, '未分配') ORDER BY weighted_forecast DESC

description: Aggregated forecast KPIs: total pipeline, weighted forecast, win rate, avg deal size
fromSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost') THEN crm_opp_expected_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_pipeline, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost') THEN crm_opp_expected_amount * COALESCE(crm_opp_probability, CASE crm_opp_stage WHEN 'discovery' THEN 10 WHEN 'qualification' THEN 25 WHEN 'proposal' THEN 50 WHEN 'negotiation' THEN 75 ELSE 10 END) / 100 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS weighted_forecast, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN crm_opp_stage = 'closed_won' THEN crm_opp_expected_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS won_revenue, CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN crm_opp_stage IN ('closed_won','closed_lost') THEN 1 END) > 0 THEN ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN crm_opp_stage = 'closed_won' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN crm_opp_stage IN ('closed_won','closed_lost') THEN 1 END), 4) ELSE 0 END AS win_rate, COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost') THEN crm_opp_expected_amount END), 0) AS avg_deal_size, COUNT(CASE WHEN crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost') THEN 1 END) AS open_deals FROM mt_crm_opportunity_common WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}

description: Detailed list of open opportunities with weighted forecast for forecast table view
fromSql: SELECT o.pid, o.crm_opp_name, o.crm_opp_stage, o.crm_opp_expected_amount, o.crm_opp_probability, COALESCE(o.crm_opp_expected_amount * COALESCE(o.crm_opp_probability, CASE o.crm_opp_stage WHEN 'discovery' THEN 10 WHEN 'qualification' THEN 25 WHEN 'proposal' THEN 50 WHEN 'negotiation' THEN 75 ELSE 10 END) / 100, 0) AS weighted_amount, o.crm_opp_expected_close_date, COALESCE(a.crm_acc_name, 'N/A') AS account_name FROM mt_crm_opportunity_common o LEFT JOIN mt_crm_account_common a ON o.crm_opp_account_id = a.pid AND a.tenant_id = o.tenant_id WHERE o.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND o.crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost') ORDER BY weighted_amount DESC

description: Email log counts grouped by status: sent, delivered, opened, bounced, failed
fromSql: SELECT crm_el_status AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM mt_crm_email_log WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} GROUP BY crm_el_status ORDER BY count DESC

description: Aggregated metrics for a specific campaign: total members, leads, emails, avg rates
fromSql: SELECT members.total_members, COALESCE(SUM(metrics.crm_cmet_leads_generated), 0) AS total_leads, COALESCE(SUM(metrics.crm_cmet_emails_sent), 0) AS total_emails, ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(metrics.crm_cmet_open_rate), 0), 1) AS avg_open_rate, ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(metrics.crm_cmet_click_rate), 0), 1) AS avg_click_rate, ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(metrics.crm_cmet_conversion_rate), 0), 1) AS avg_conversion_rate, COALESCE(SUM(metrics.crm_cmet_cost), 0) AS total_cost, COALESCE(SUM(metrics.crm_cmet_revenue), 0) AS total_revenue, CASE WHEN SUM(metrics.crm_cmet_cost) > 0 THEN ROUND((SUM(metrics.crm_cmet_revenue) - SUM(metrics.crm_cmet_cost)) / SUM(metrics.crm_cmet_cost) * 100, 1) ELSE 0 END AS overall_roi FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_members FROM mt_crm_campaign_member WHERE crm_cm_campaign_id = #{params.campaignId} AND tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}) members LEFT JOIN mt_crm_campaign_metric metrics ON metrics.crm_cmet_campaign_id = #{params.campaignId} AND metrics.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} GROUP BY members.total_members

description: Campaign performance grouped by campaign type: total cost, revenue, ROI, lead count
fromSql: SELECT c.crm_cpn_type AS campaign_type, COUNT(DISTINCT c.pid) AS campaign_count, COALESCE(SUM(m.crm_cmet_cost), 0) AS total_cost, COALESCE(SUM(m.crm_cmet_revenue), 0) AS total_revenue, CASE WHEN SUM(m.crm_cmet_cost) > 0 THEN ROUND((SUM(m.crm_cmet_revenue) - SUM(m.crm_cmet_cost)) / SUM(m.crm_cmet_cost) * 100, 1) ELSE 0 END AS roi, COALESCE(SUM(m.crm_cmet_leads_generated), 0) AS total_leads FROM mt_crm_campaign c LEFT JOIN mt_crm_campaign_metric m ON c.pid = m.crm_cmet_campaign_id AND m.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} WHERE c.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} GROUP BY c.crm_cpn_type ORDER BY roi DESC

description: Complaint counts grouped by SLA status for service desk dashboard
fromSql: SELECT COALESCE(crm_cmp_sla_status, 'none') AS sla_status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM mt_crm_complaint WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND crm_cmp_status IN ('open', 'investigating') GROUP BY crm_cmp_sla_status ORDER BY count DESC

description: Average hours for first response and full resolution across complaints
fromSql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (crm_cmp_first_response_at - crm_cmp_date)) / 3600), 1) AS avg_response_hours, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN crm_cmp_resolution_date IS NOT NULL THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (crm_cmp_resolution_date - crm_cmp_date)) / 3600 END), 1) AS avg_resolution_hours, COUNT(CASE WHEN crm_cmp_sla_status = 'breached' THEN 1 END) AS breach_count, COUNT(*) AS total_complaints FROM mt_crm_complaint WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}

description: Count of email templates grouped by category and status
fromSql: SELECT crm_et_category AS category, crm_et_status AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM mt_crm_email_template WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} GROUP BY crm_et_category, crm_et_status ORDER BY category, status

description: Open-pipeline forecast grouped by the manager-set forecast category (commit / best_case / pipeline / omitted), independent of stage. Sums expected and weighted amounts per category for the forecast board pivot.
fromSql: SELECT COALESCE(crm_opp_forecast_category, 'pipeline') AS forecast_category, COUNT(*) AS opportunity_count, COALESCE(SUM(crm_opp_expected_amount), 0) AS total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(crm_opp_expected_amount * COALESCE(crm_opp_probability, CASE crm_opp_stage WHEN 'discovery' THEN 10 WHEN 'qualification' THEN 25 WHEN 'proposal' THEN 50 WHEN 'negotiation' THEN 75 ELSE 10 END) / 100), 0) AS weighted_forecast FROM mt_crm_opportunity_common WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost') GROUP BY COALESCE(crm_opp_forecast_category, 'pipeline') ORDER BY weighted_forecast DESC

description: Open opportunities (not closed_won/closed_lost) that have not been updated since the supplied staleBefore timestamp — i.e. stuck in their current stage. Use oppKeyword to narrow opportunity/account names. Drives the stage-stall early-warning list.
fromSql: SELECT o.pid, o.crm_opp_code AS code, o.crm_opp_name AS name, COALESCE(a.crm_acc_name, '') AS account_name, o.crm_opp_stage AS stage, o.crm_opp_owner AS owner, o.crm_opp_expected_amount AS expected_amount, o.updated_at AS last_updated, EXTRACT(DAY FROM (now() - o.updated_at))::int AS days_in_stage FROM mt_crm_opportunity_common o LEFT JOIN mt_crm_account_common a ON o.crm_opp_account_id = a.pid AND a.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} WHERE o.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND o.crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost') AND (COALESCE(CAST(#{params.oppKeyword} AS text), '') = '' OR o.crm_opp_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', CAST(#{params.oppKeyword} AS text), '%') OR a.crm_acc_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', CAST(#{params.oppKeyword} AS text), '%')) AND o.updated_at < CAST(#{params.staleBefore} AS timestamp) ORDER BY o.updated_at ASC

description: Distribution of closed_lost opportunities by lost-reason code, with count and total lost amount. Drives the win/loss board's loss-analysis chart.
fromSql: SELECT COALESCE(crm_opp_lost_reason_code, 'other') AS lost_reason, COUNT(*) AS lost_count, COALESCE(SUM(crm_opp_expected_amount), 0) AS lost_amount FROM mt_crm_opportunity_common WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND crm_opp_stage = 'closed_lost' GROUP BY COALESCE(crm_opp_lost_reason_code, 'other') ORDER BY lost_count DESC

description: Manager review queue over generic CRM customer requests. Aggregates pipeline amount, lightweight quote summaries, approval cases, and direct task risk without depending on any industry-specific quote or BOM model.
fromSql: SELECT cr.pid, cr.crm_cr_code, cr.crm_cr_title, cr.crm_cr_account_id, cr.crm_cr_opportunity_id, cr.crm_cr_priority, cr.crm_cr_status, cr.crm_cr_route_status, cr.crm_cr_expected_date, cr.crm_cr_owner, opp.crm_opp_name AS crm_mw_opp_name, opp.crm_opp_stage AS crm_mw_opp_stage, opp.crm_opp_expected_amount AS crm_mw_opp_expected_amount, opp.crm_opp_expected_close_date AS crm_mw_opp_expected_close_date, COALESCE(qs.quote_count, 0) AS crm_mw_quote_count, COALESCE(qs.quote_amount, 0) AS crm_mw_quote_amount, qs.latest_quote_valid_until AS crm_mw_latest_quote_valid_until, COALESCE(apc.pending_approval_count, 0) AS crm_mw_pending_approval_count, COALESCE(tasks.open_task_count, 0) AS crm_mw_open_task_count, COALESCE(tasks.overdue_task_count, 0) AS crm_mw_overdue_task_count, CASE WHEN cr.crm_cr_route_status = 'failed' THEN 'route_failed' WHEN COALESCE(apc.pending_approval_count, 0) > 0 THEN 'approval_pending' WHEN COALESCE(tasks.overdue_task_count, 0) > 0 THEN 'task_overdue' WHEN cr.crm_cr_expected_date IS NOT NULL AND cr.crm_cr_expected_date < CURRENT_DATE AND cr.crm_cr_status NOT IN ('won', 'lost', 'cancelled') THEN 'request_overdue' WHEN COALESCE(qs.quote_count, 0) = 0 AND cr.crm_cr_status IN ('routed', 'in_progress', 'quoted') THEN 'quote_missing' ELSE 'watch' END AS crm_mw_risk_reason, (CURRENT_DATE - cr.created_at::date) AS crm_mw_age_days FROM mt_crm_customer_request_common cr LEFT JOIN mt_crm_opportunity_common opp ON opp.pid = cr.crm_cr_opportunity_id AND opp.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} LEFT JOIN (SELECT crm_qs_customer_request_id AS request_id, COUNT(*) AS quote_count, COALESCE(SUM(crm_qs_quote_amount), 0) AS quote_amount, MAX(crm_qs_valid_until) AS latest_quote_valid_until FROM mt_crm_quote_summary_common WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} GROUP BY crm_qs_customer_request_id) qs ON qs.request_id = cr.pid LEFT JOIN (SELECT crm_apc_customer_request_id AS request_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE crm_apc_status = 'pending') AS pending_approval_count FROM mt_crm_approval_case_common WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} GROUP BY crm_apc_customer_request_id) apc ON apc.request_id = cr.pid LEFT JOIN (SELECT crm_act_related_id AS request_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE crm_act_ext->>'status' IN ('open', 'in_progress')) AS open_task_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE crm_act_ext->>'status' IN ('open', 'in_progress') AND NULLIF(crm_act_ext->>'dueDate', '')::date < CURRENT_DATE) AS overdue_task_count FROM mt_crm_activity_common WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND crm_act_type = 'task' AND crm_act_related_model = 'crm_customer_request_common' GROUP BY crm_act_related_id) tasks ON tasks.request_id = cr.pid WHERE cr.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} ORDER BY COALESCE(apc.pending_approval_count, 0) DESC, COALESCE(tasks.overdue_task_count, 0) DESC, cr.crm_cr_expected_date ASC NULLS LAST, cr.created_at DESC

description: One-row aggregate of QDP revisions by actionable release lifecycle state.
purpose: Feeds the QDP Release Workbench metric strip and deliberately returns one row.
fromSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE crm_qdp_status IN ('draft', 'validation_failed')) AS action_required_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE crm_qdp_status = 'ready_for_review') AS ready_for_release_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE crm_qdp_status = 'compiling') AS compiling_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE crm_qdp_status = 'released') AS released_count FROM mt_crm_qdp_revision_common WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}

description: One-row customer portfolio summary shared by the Customer 360 metric strip and queue filters.
fromSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_accounts, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.crm_acc_status = 'active') AS active_accounts, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(o.open_opportunities, 0) > 0) AS pipeline_accounts, COALESCE(SUM(o.pipeline_amount), 0) AS open_pipeline_amount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.open_complaints, 0) > 0) AS service_risk_accounts FROM mt_crm_account_common a LEFT JOIN (SELECT crm_opp_account_id AS account_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost')) AS open_opportunities, COALESCE(SUM(crm_opp_expected_amount) FILTER (WHERE crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost')), 0) AS pipeline_amount FROM mt_crm_opportunity_common WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} GROUP BY crm_opp_account_id) o ON o.account_id = a.pid LEFT JOIN (SELECT crm_cmp_account_id AS account_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE crm_cmp_status IN ('open', 'investigating')) AS open_complaints FROM mt_crm_complaint WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} GROUP BY crm_cmp_account_id) c ON c.account_id = a.pid WHERE a.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}

description: Customer portfolio queue with relationship, pipeline, activity and service risk context.
fromSql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.pid, a.crm_acc_code, a.crm_acc_name, a.crm_acc_industry, a.crm_acc_rating, a.crm_acc_status, a.crm_acc_owner, COALESCE(u.nick_name, u.user_name, '未分配') AS owner_name, a.crm_acc_health_score, a.crm_acc_health_band, COALESCE(ct.contact_count, 0) AS contact_count, COALESCE(o.open_opportunities, 0) AS open_opportunities, COALESCE(o.pipeline_amount, 0) AS pipeline_amount, act.last_activity_at, CASE WHEN act.last_activity_at IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE EXTRACT(DAY FROM (now() - act.last_activity_at))::int END AS days_since_activity, COALESCE(c.open_complaints, 0) AS open_complaints, CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.open_complaints, 0) > 0 THEN 'service_risk' WHEN a.crm_acc_health_band = 'red' THEN 'health_risk' WHEN COALESCE(o.open_opportunities, 0) > 0 THEN 'pipeline' WHEN a.crm_acc_status = 'active' THEN 'active' ELSE 'watch' END AS attention_reason FROM mt_crm_account_common a LEFT JOIN ab_user u ON u.pid = a.crm_acc_owner LEFT JOIN (SELECT crm_ct_account_id AS account_id, COUNT(*) AS contact_count FROM mt_crm_contact_common WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} GROUP BY crm_ct_account_id) ct ON ct.account_id = a.pid LEFT JOIN (SELECT crm_opp_account_id AS account_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost')) AS open_opportunities, COALESCE(SUM(crm_opp_expected_amount) FILTER (WHERE crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost')), 0) AS pipeline_amount FROM mt_crm_opportunity_common WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} GROUP BY crm_opp_account_id) o ON o.account_id = a.pid LEFT JOIN (SELECT r.crm_ar_object_id AS account_id, MAX(ac.crm_act_date) AS last_activity_at FROM mt_crm_activity_relation_common r JOIN mt_crm_activity_common ac ON ac.pid = r.crm_ar_activity_id AND ac.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} WHERE r.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND r.crm_ar_object_type = 'account' GROUP BY r.crm_ar_object_id) act ON act.account_id = a.pid LEFT JOIN (SELECT crm_cmp_account_id AS account_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE crm_cmp_status IN ('open', 'investigating')) AS open_complaints FROM mt_crm_complaint WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} GROUP BY crm_cmp_account_id) c ON c.account_id = a.pid WHERE a.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}) q WHERE (COALESCE(CAST(#{params.customerKeyword} AS text), '') = '' OR q.crm_acc_code ILIKE CONCAT('%', CAST(#{params.customerKeyword} AS text), '%') OR q.crm_acc_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', CAST(#{params.customerKeyword} AS text), '%')) AND (COALESCE(CAST(#{params.viewFilter} AS text), '') = '' OR CAST(#{params.viewFilter} AS text) = 'all' OR (CAST(#{params.viewFilter} AS text) = 'active' AND q.crm_acc_status = 'active') OR (CAST(#{params.viewFilter} AS text) = 'pipeline' AND q.open_opportunities > 0) OR (CAST(#{params.viewFilter} AS text) = 'service_risk' AND q.open_complaints > 0)) ORDER BY CASE q.attention_reason WHEN 'service_risk' THEN 1 WHEN 'health_risk' THEN 2 WHEN 'pipeline' THEN 3 WHEN 'active' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, q.pipeline_amount DESC, q.crm_acc_name

description: One-row lead workload summary for actionable, unassigned, stale and conversion-ready leads.
fromSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.crm_lead_status IN ('new', 'contacted', 'qualified')) AS actionable_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.crm_lead_status IN ('new', 'contacted', 'qualified') AND l.crm_lead_assigned_to IS NULL) AS unassigned_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.crm_lead_status IN ('new', 'contacted') AND (act.last_activity_at IS NULL OR act.last_activity_at < now() - interval '14 days')) AS stale_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.crm_lead_status = 'qualified') AS qualified_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.crm_lead_status IN ('new', 'contacted', 'qualified') AND COALESCE(l.crm_lead_score, 0) >= 70) AS high_score_count FROM mt_crm_lead_common l LEFT JOIN (SELECT r.crm_ar_object_id AS lead_id, MAX(a.crm_act_date) AS last_activity_at FROM mt_crm_activity_relation_common r JOIN mt_crm_activity_common a ON a.pid = r.crm_ar_activity_id AND a.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} WHERE r.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND r.crm_ar_object_type = 'lead' GROUP BY r.crm_ar_object_id) act ON act.lead_id = l.pid WHERE l.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}

description: Lead queue ordered by assignment, staleness and score with an explicit recommended next action.
fromSql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT l.pid, l.crm_lead_code, l.crm_lead_company, l.crm_lead_contact_name, l.crm_lead_source, l.crm_lead_industry, l.crm_lead_score, l.crm_lead_status, l.crm_lead_assigned_to, COALESCE(u.nick_name, u.user_name, '未分配') AS owner_name, act.last_activity_at, CASE WHEN act.last_activity_at IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE EXTRACT(DAY FROM (now() - act.last_activity_at))::int END AS days_since_activity, CASE WHEN l.crm_lead_assigned_to IS NULL THEN 'assign_owner' WHEN l.crm_lead_status = 'qualified' THEN 'convert' WHEN COALESCE(l.crm_lead_score, 0) >= 70 AND l.crm_lead_status IN ('new', 'contacted') THEN 'qualify' WHEN act.last_activity_at IS NULL OR act.last_activity_at < now() - interval '14 days' THEN 'follow_up' ELSE 'continue_nurture' END AS next_action FROM mt_crm_lead_common l LEFT JOIN ab_user u ON u.pid = l.crm_lead_assigned_to LEFT JOIN (SELECT r.crm_ar_object_id AS lead_id, MAX(a.crm_act_date) AS last_activity_at FROM mt_crm_activity_relation_common r JOIN mt_crm_activity_common a ON a.pid = r.crm_ar_activity_id AND a.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} WHERE r.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND r.crm_ar_object_type = 'lead' GROUP BY r.crm_ar_object_id) act ON act.lead_id = l.pid WHERE l.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND l.crm_lead_status IN ('new', 'contacted', 'qualified')) q WHERE (COALESCE(CAST(#{params.leadKeyword} AS text), '') = '' OR q.crm_lead_code ILIKE CONCAT('%', CAST(#{params.leadKeyword} AS text), '%') OR q.crm_lead_company ILIKE CONCAT('%', CAST(#{params.leadKeyword} AS text), '%') OR q.crm_lead_contact_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', CAST(#{params.leadKeyword} AS text), '%')) AND (COALESCE(CAST(#{params.viewFilter} AS text), '') = '' OR CAST(#{params.viewFilter} AS text) = 'all' OR (CAST(#{params.viewFilter} AS text) = 'unassigned' AND q.crm_lead_assigned_to IS NULL) OR (CAST(#{params.viewFilter} AS text) = 'stale' AND (q.last_activity_at IS NULL OR q.days_since_activity >= 14)) OR (CAST(#{params.viewFilter} AS text) = 'qualified' AND q.crm_lead_status = 'qualified')) ORDER BY CASE q.next_action WHEN 'assign_owner' THEN 1 WHEN 'convert' THEN 2 WHEN 'qualify' THEN 3 WHEN 'follow_up' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, q.crm_lead_score DESC NULLS LAST, q.last_activity_at ASC NULLS FIRST

description: One-row open pipeline summary including weighted value, close pressure and risk.
fromSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost')) AS open_deals, COALESCE(SUM(o.crm_opp_expected_amount) FILTER (WHERE o.crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost')), 0) AS pipeline_amount, COALESCE(SUM(o.crm_opp_expected_amount * COALESCE(o.crm_opp_probability, 0) / 100) FILTER (WHERE o.crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost')), 0) AS weighted_amount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost') AND (o.crm_opp_expected_close_date < now() OR o.updated_at < now() - interval '14 days' OR COALESCE(r.open_risks, 0) > 0)) AS at_risk_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost') AND o.crm_opp_expected_close_date >= now() AND o.crm_opp_expected_close_date < now() + interval '30 days') AS closing_30_count FROM mt_crm_opportunity_common o LEFT JOIN (SELECT crm_rk_source_id AS opportunity_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE crm_rk_status IN ('open', 'mitigating')) AS open_risks FROM mt_crm_risk_common WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND crm_rk_source_model = 'crm_opportunity_common' GROUP BY crm_rk_source_id) r ON r.opportunity_id = o.pid WHERE o.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}

description: Open opportunity queue with account, last activity, risk, quote readiness and an explicit next action.
fromSql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT o.pid, o.crm_opp_code, o.crm_opp_name, COALESCE(a.crm_acc_name, '') AS account_name, o.crm_opp_stage, o.crm_opp_expected_amount, o.crm_opp_probability, o.crm_opp_expected_close_date, o.crm_opp_forecast_category, o.crm_opp_owner, COALESCE(u.nick_name, u.user_name, '未分配') AS owner_name, act.last_activity_at, CASE WHEN act.last_activity_at IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE EXTRACT(DAY FROM (now() - act.last_activity_at))::int END AS days_since_activity, COALESCE(r.open_risks, 0) AS open_risks, COALESCE(q.quote_count, 0) AS quote_count, CASE WHEN o.crm_opp_expected_close_date < now() THEN 'close_date_overdue' WHEN COALESCE(r.open_risks, 0) > 0 THEN 'mitigate_risk' WHEN act.last_activity_at IS NULL OR act.last_activity_at < now() - interval '14 days' THEN 'follow_up' WHEN o.crm_opp_stage IN ('proposal', 'negotiation') AND COALESCE(q.quote_count, 0) = 0 THEN 'prepare_quote' ELSE 'advance_stage' END AS next_action FROM mt_crm_opportunity_common o LEFT JOIN mt_crm_account_common a ON a.pid = o.crm_opp_account_id AND a.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} LEFT JOIN ab_user u ON u.pid = o.crm_opp_owner LEFT JOIN (SELECT r.crm_ar_object_id AS opportunity_id, MAX(ac.crm_act_date) AS last_activity_at FROM mt_crm_activity_relation_common r JOIN mt_crm_activity_common ac ON ac.pid = r.crm_ar_activity_id AND ac.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} WHERE r.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND r.crm_ar_object_type = 'opportunity' GROUP BY r.crm_ar_object_id) act ON act.opportunity_id = o.pid LEFT JOIN (SELECT crm_rk_source_id AS opportunity_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE crm_rk_status IN ('open', 'mitigating')) AS open_risks FROM mt_crm_risk_common WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND crm_rk_source_model = 'crm_opportunity_common' GROUP BY crm_rk_source_id) r ON r.opportunity_id = o.pid LEFT JOIN (SELECT crm_qs_opportunity_id AS opportunity_id, COUNT(*) AS quote_count FROM mt_crm_quote_summary_common WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} GROUP BY crm_qs_opportunity_id) q ON q.opportunity_id = o.pid WHERE o.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND o.crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost')) q WHERE (COALESCE(CAST(#{params.oppKeyword} AS text), '') = '' OR q.crm_opp_code ILIKE CONCAT('%', CAST(#{params.oppKeyword} AS text), '%') OR q.crm_opp_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', CAST(#{params.oppKeyword} AS text), '%') OR q.account_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', CAST(#{params.oppKeyword} AS text), '%')) AND (COALESCE(CAST(#{params.viewFilter} AS text), '') = '' OR CAST(#{params.viewFilter} AS text) = 'all' OR (CAST(#{params.viewFilter} AS text) = 'at_risk' AND q.next_action IN ('close_date_overdue', 'mitigate_risk', 'follow_up')) OR (CAST(#{params.viewFilter} AS text) = 'closing_30' AND q.crm_opp_expected_close_date >= now() AND q.crm_opp_expected_close_date < now() + interval '30 days') OR (CAST(#{params.viewFilter} AS text) = 'proposal' AND q.crm_opp_stage IN ('proposal', 'negotiation'))) ORDER BY CASE q.next_action WHEN 'close_date_overdue' THEN 1 WHEN 'mitigate_risk' THEN 2 WHEN 'follow_up' THEN 3 WHEN 'prepare_quote' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, q.crm_opp_expected_close_date ASC NULLS LAST, q.crm_opp_expected_amount DESC

description: One-row sales forecast and submission-review summary.
fromSql: SELECT o.commit_amount, o.best_case_amount, o.total_pipeline, o.weighted_forecast, o.open_deals, f.draft_submissions, f.submitted_count FROM (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(crm_opp_expected_amount) FILTER (WHERE crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost') AND crm_opp_forecast_category = 'commit'), 0) AS commit_amount, COALESCE(SUM(crm_opp_expected_amount) FILTER (WHERE crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost') AND crm_opp_forecast_category IN ('commit','best_case')), 0) AS best_case_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost') THEN crm_opp_expected_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_pipeline, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost') THEN crm_opp_expected_amount * COALESCE(crm_opp_probability, 0) / 100 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS weighted_forecast, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost')) AS open_deals FROM mt_crm_opportunity_common WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}) o CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE crm_fcst_status = 'draft') AS draft_submissions, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE crm_fcst_status = 'submitted') AS submitted_count FROM mt_crm_forecast_submission WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}) f

description: Compares one selected forecast submission with the current open-pipeline facts for the same owner. Returns one row per forecast measure so the review surface stays compact and explainable.
fromSql: SELECT f.pid AS submission_pid, f.crm_fcst_period AS forecast_period, COALESCE(u.nick_name, u.user_name, '未分配') AS owner_name, v.measure, CASE v.measure WHEN 'commit' THEN COALESCE(f.crm_fcst_commit_amount, 0) WHEN 'best_case' THEN COALESCE(f.crm_fcst_best_case_amount, 0) ELSE COALESCE(f.crm_fcst_pipeline_amount, 0) END AS submitted_amount, CASE v.measure WHEN 'commit' THEN COALESCE(SUM(o.crm_opp_expected_amount) FILTER (WHERE o.crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost') AND o.crm_opp_forecast_category = 'commit'), 0) WHEN 'best_case' THEN COALESCE(SUM(o.crm_opp_expected_amount) FILTER (WHERE o.crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost') AND o.crm_opp_forecast_category IN ('commit','best_case')), 0) ELSE COALESCE(SUM(o.crm_opp_expected_amount) FILTER (WHERE o.crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost')), 0) END AS current_amount, CASE v.measure WHEN 'commit' THEN COALESCE(SUM(o.crm_opp_expected_amount) FILTER (WHERE o.crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost') AND o.crm_opp_forecast_category = 'commit'), 0) - COALESCE(f.crm_fcst_commit_amount, 0) WHEN 'best_case' THEN COALESCE(SUM(o.crm_opp_expected_amount) FILTER (WHERE o.crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost') AND o.crm_opp_forecast_category IN ('commit','best_case')), 0) - COALESCE(f.crm_fcst_best_case_amount, 0) ELSE COALESCE(SUM(o.crm_opp_expected_amount) FILTER (WHERE o.crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost')), 0) - COALESCE(f.crm_fcst_pipeline_amount, 0) END AS variance_amount FROM mt_crm_forecast_submission f LEFT JOIN ab_user u ON u.pid = f.crm_fcst_owner LEFT JOIN mt_crm_opportunity_common o ON o.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND o.crm_opp_owner IS NOT DISTINCT FROM f.crm_fcst_owner CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('commit'), ('best_case'), ('pipeline')) AS v(measure) WHERE f.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND f.pid = CAST(#{params.submissionPid} AS text) GROUP BY f.pid, f.crm_fcst_period, f.crm_fcst_commit_amount, f.crm_fcst_best_case_amount, f.crm_fcst_pipeline_amount, u.nick_name, u.user_name, v.measure ORDER BY CASE v.measure WHEN 'commit' THEN 1 WHEN 'best_case' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

description: Returns the exact open opportunities behind a selected forecast owner's current rollup, ordered by overdue, risk, staleness and quote readiness so a manager can explain the variance and drill into the record.
fromSql: SELECT o.pid, o.crm_opp_code, o.crm_opp_name, COALESCE(a.crm_acc_name, '') AS account_name, o.crm_opp_stage, COALESCE(o.crm_opp_forecast_category, 'pipeline') AS forecast_category, o.crm_opp_expected_amount, o.crm_opp_probability, o.crm_opp_expected_close_date, act.last_activity_at, COALESCE(r.open_risks, 0) AS open_risks, CASE WHEN o.crm_opp_expected_close_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN 'close_date_overdue' WHEN COALESCE(r.open_risks, 0) > 0 THEN 'mitigate_risk' WHEN act.last_activity_at IS NULL OR act.last_activity_at < now() - interval '14 days' THEN 'follow_up' WHEN o.crm_opp_stage IN ('proposal', 'negotiation') AND COALESCE(q.quote_count, 0) = 0 THEN 'prepare_quote' ELSE 'advance_stage' END AS variance_driver FROM mt_crm_forecast_submission f JOIN mt_crm_opportunity_common o ON o.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND o.crm_opp_owner IS NOT DISTINCT FROM f.crm_fcst_owner LEFT JOIN mt_crm_account_common a ON a.pid = o.crm_opp_account_id AND a.tenant_id = o.tenant_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT ar.crm_ar_object_id AS opportunity_id, MAX(ac.crm_act_date) AS last_activity_at FROM mt_crm_activity_relation_common ar JOIN mt_crm_activity_common ac ON ac.pid = ar.crm_ar_activity_id AND ac.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} WHERE ar.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND ar.crm_ar_object_type = 'opportunity' GROUP BY ar.crm_ar_object_id) act ON act.opportunity_id = o.pid LEFT JOIN (SELECT crm_rk_source_id AS opportunity_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE crm_rk_status IN ('open', 'mitigating')) AS open_risks FROM mt_crm_risk_common WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND crm_rk_source_model = 'crm_opportunity_common' GROUP BY crm_rk_source_id) r ON r.opportunity_id = o.pid LEFT JOIN (SELECT crm_qs_opportunity_id AS opportunity_id, COUNT(*) AS quote_count FROM mt_crm_quote_summary_common WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} GROUP BY crm_qs_opportunity_id) q ON q.opportunity_id = o.pid WHERE f.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND f.pid = CAST(#{params.submissionPid} AS text) AND o.crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost') ORDER BY CASE WHEN o.crm_opp_expected_close_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN 1 WHEN COALESCE(r.open_risks, 0) > 0 THEN 2 WHEN act.last_activity_at IS NULL OR act.last_activity_at < now() - interval '14 days' THEN 3 WHEN o.crm_opp_stage IN ('proposal', 'negotiation') AND COALESCE(q.quote_count, 0) = 0 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, o.crm_opp_expected_amount DESC, o.crm_opp_expected_close_date ASC NULLS LAST

name:zh-CN: 活动与服务工作台统计
description: One-row task and complaint workload summary for the shared activity/service queue.
fromSql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mt_crm_activity_common a WHERE a.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND a.crm_act_type = 'task' AND a.crm_act_ext->>'status' IN ('open', 'in_progress')) AS open_tasks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mt_crm_activity_common a WHERE a.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND a.crm_act_type = 'task' AND a.crm_act_ext->>'status' IN ('open', 'in_progress') AND NULLIF(a.crm_act_ext->>'dueDate', '')::date < CURRENT_DATE) AS overdue_tasks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mt_crm_activity_common a WHERE a.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND a.crm_act_type = 'task' AND a.crm_act_ext->>'status' IN ('open', 'in_progress') AND NULLIF(a.crm_act_ext->>'dueDate', '')::date = CURRENT_DATE) AS due_today, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mt_crm_complaint c WHERE c.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND c.crm_cmp_status IN ('open', 'investigating')) AS open_complaints, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mt_crm_complaint c WHERE c.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND c.crm_cmp_status IN ('open', 'investigating') AND c.crm_cmp_sla_status = 'breached') AS sla_breaches

description: Unified task and complaint queue with compatible state fields for role-based next actions.
fromSql: SELECT q.*, COALESCE(u.nick_name, u.user_name, '未分配') AS owner_name FROM (SELECT COALESCE(a.pid, c.pid) AS pid, CASE WHEN a.pid IS NOT NULL THEN 'task' ELSE 'complaint' END AS item_kind, CASE WHEN a.pid IS NOT NULL THEN a.crm_act_subject ELSE CONCAT(c.crm_cmp_code, ' · ', LEFT(c.crm_cmp_description, 80)) END AS item_title, CASE WHEN a.pid IS NOT NULL THEN a.crm_act_ext->>'status' ELSE c.crm_cmp_status END AS item_status, CASE WHEN a.pid IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(a.crm_act_ext->>'priority', 'normal') ELSE c.crm_cmp_severity END AS item_priority, CASE WHEN a.pid IS NOT NULL THEN NULLIF(a.crm_act_ext->>'dueDate', '')::date ELSE c.crm_cmp_date::date END AS due_date, CASE WHEN a.pid IS NOT NULL THEN a.crm_act_owner ELSE NULL::text END AS item_owner, CASE WHEN a.pid IS NOT NULL THEN a.crm_act_owner ELSE NULL::text END AS crm_act_owner, CASE WHEN a.pid IS NOT NULL THEN a.crm_act_related_model ELSE 'crm_account_common' END AS related_model, CASE WHEN a.pid IS NOT NULL THEN a.crm_act_related_id ELSE c.crm_cmp_account_id END AS related_id, CASE WHEN a.pid IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(a.crm_act_ext->>'dueDate', '')::date < CURRENT_DATE THEN 'overdue' WHEN a.pid IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(a.crm_act_ext->>'dueDate', '')::date = CURRENT_DATE THEN 'due_today' WHEN a.pid IS NOT NULL THEN 'task' WHEN c.crm_cmp_status = 'resolved' THEN 'ready_to_close' WHEN c.crm_cmp_sla_status = 'breached' THEN 'sla_breach' ELSE 'service' END AS attention_reason FROM mt_crm_activity_common a FULL OUTER JOIN mt_crm_complaint c ON FALSE WHERE (a.pid IS NOT NULL AND a.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND a.crm_act_type = 'task' AND a.crm_act_ext->>'status' IN ('open', 'in_progress')) OR (c.pid IS NOT NULL AND c.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND c.crm_cmp_status IN ('open', 'investigating', 'resolved'))) q LEFT JOIN ab_user u ON u.pid = q.item_owner WHERE (COALESCE(CAST(#{params.workKeyword} AS text), '') = '' OR q.item_title ILIKE CONCAT('%', CAST(#{params.workKeyword} AS text), '%') OR COALESCE(q.item_owner, '') ILIKE CONCAT('%', CAST(#{params.workKeyword} AS text), '%')) AND (COALESCE(CAST(#{params.viewFilter} AS text), '') = '' OR CAST(#{params.viewFilter} AS text) = 'all' OR (CAST(#{params.viewFilter} AS text) = 'overdue' AND q.attention_reason = 'overdue') OR (CAST(#{params.viewFilter} AS text) = 'due_today' AND q.attention_reason = 'due_today') OR (CAST(#{params.viewFilter} AS text) = 'service' AND q.item_kind = 'complaint') OR (CAST(#{params.viewFilter} AS text) = 'sla_breach' AND q.attention_reason = 'sla_breach')) ORDER BY CASE q.attention_reason WHEN 'sla_breach' THEN 1 WHEN 'overdue' THEN 2 WHEN 'due_today' THEN 3 WHEN 'service' THEN 4 WHEN 'ready_to_close' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END, q.due_date ASC NULLS LAST

description: One-row operational summary using the same cooldown, daily quota and customer-capacity decisions as the claim command.
fromSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.crm_cpi_status = 'available') AS available_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.operational_state = 'ready') AS ready_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.operational_state = 'cooldown') AS cooldown_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.operational_state IN ('cooldown', 'quota_blocked', 'capacity_blocked')) AS blocked_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.crm_cpi_status IN ('claimed', 'assigned')) AS owned_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.crm_cpi_status IN ('recycling', 'recycling_retry')) AS processing_count FROM (SELECT b.crm_cpi_status, CASE WHEN b.crm_cpi_status <> 'available' THEN b.crm_cpi_status WHEN b.capacity_limit IS NOT NULL AND b.owned_customer_count >= b.capacity_limit THEN 'capacity_blocked' WHEN NOT b.is_pool_admin AND b.effective_release_at > now() THEN 'cooldown' WHEN NOT b.is_pool_admin AND b.daily_claim_count >= b.daily_claim_limit THEN 'quota_blocked' ELSE 'ready' END AS operational_state FROM (SELECT i.crm_cpi_status, p.crm_cp_daily_pick_limit AS daily_claim_limit, COALESCE(quota.crm_cpq_pick_count, 0) AS daily_claim_count, capacity.crm_ccap_capacity AS capacity_limit, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mt_crm_account_common owned WHERE owned.tenant_id = i.tenant_id AND owned.crm_acc_owner = current_actor.pid AND owned.crm_acc_status = 'active' AND COALESCE(owned.crm_acc_pool_state, '') <> 'in_pool') AS owned_customer_count, p.crm_cp_admin_user_ids LIKE CONCAT('%"', current_actor.pid, '"%') AS is_pool_admin, CASE WHEN current_actor.pid = i.crm_cpi_previous_owner THEN GREATEST(i.crm_cpi_claim_release_at, i.crm_cpi_entered_at + make_interval(days => COALESCE(p.crm_cp_previous_owner_cooldown_days, 0))) ELSE i.crm_cpi_claim_release_at END AS effective_release_at FROM mt_crm_customer_pool_item_common i JOIN mt_crm_customer_pool_common p ON p.pid = i.crm_cpi_pool_id AND p.tenant_id = i.tenant_id JOIN ab_user current_actor ON current_actor.id = CAST(#{params.currentUserId} AS bigint) LEFT JOIN mt_crm_customer_pool_quota_common quota ON quota.tenant_id = i.tenant_id AND quota.crm_cpq_pool_id = i.crm_cpi_pool_id AND quota.crm_cpq_user_id = current_actor.pid AND quota.crm_cpq_local_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date LEFT JOIN mt_crm_customer_capacity_common capacity ON capacity.tenant_id = i.tenant_id AND capacity.crm_ccap_user_id = current_actor.pid AND capacity.crm_ccap_status = 'active' WHERE i.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND (p.crm_cp_member_user_ids LIKE CONCAT('%"', current_actor.pid, '"%') OR p.crm_cp_admin_user_ids LIKE CONCAT('%"', current_actor.pid, '"%'))) b) s

name:zh-CN: 客户公海领取与分配队列
name:en: Customer Pool Claim and Assignment Queue
description: Dense customer queue with policy context and explicit readiness for claim and assignment decisions.
fromSql: SELECT q.* FROM (SELECT assessed.*, CASE WHEN assessed.operational_state = 'cooldown' THEN assessed.effective_release_at WHEN assessed.operational_state = 'quota_blocked' THEN assessed.quota_reset_at ELSE NULL END AS next_eligible_at FROM (SELECT b.*, CASE WHEN b.crm_cpi_status <> 'available' THEN b.crm_cpi_status WHEN b.capacity_limit IS NOT NULL AND b.owned_customer_count >= b.capacity_limit THEN 'capacity_blocked' WHEN NOT b.is_pool_admin AND b.effective_release_at > now() THEN 'cooldown' WHEN NOT b.is_pool_admin AND b.daily_claim_count >= b.daily_claim_limit THEN 'quota_blocked' ELSE 'ready' END AS operational_state FROM (SELECT i.pid, i.crm_cpi_account_id, i.crm_cpi_pool_id, p.crm_cp_name AS pool_name, i.crm_cpi_status, i.crm_cpi_account_code, i.crm_cpi_account_name, i.crm_cpi_rating, i.crm_cpi_phone, i.crm_cpi_industry, i.crm_cpi_health_score, i.crm_cpi_entered_at, i.crm_cpi_reason, i.crm_cpi_claim_release_at, i.crm_cpi_claimed_at, i.crm_cpi_claimed_by, COALESCE(owner_user.nick_name, owner_user.user_name, i.crm_cpi_claimed_by, '') AS owner_name, i.crm_cpi_previous_owner, COALESCE(previous_user.nick_name, previous_user.user_name, i.crm_cpi_previous_owner, '') AS previous_owner_name, p.crm_cp_daily_pick_limit AS daily_claim_limit, COALESCE(quota.crm_cpq_pick_count, 0) AS daily_claim_count, capacity.crm_ccap_capacity AS capacity_limit, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mt_crm_account_common owned WHERE owned.tenant_id = i.tenant_id AND owned.crm_acc_owner = current_actor.pid AND owned.crm_acc_status = 'active' AND COALESCE(owned.crm_acc_pool_state, '') <> 'in_pool') AS owned_customer_count, p.crm_cp_admin_user_ids LIKE CONCAT('%"', current_actor.pid, '"%') AS is_pool_admin, CASE WHEN current_actor.pid = i.crm_cpi_previous_owner THEN GREATEST(i.crm_cpi_claim_release_at, i.crm_cpi_entered_at + make_interval(days => COALESCE(p.crm_cp_previous_owner_cooldown_days, 0))) ELSE i.crm_cpi_claim_release_at END AS effective_release_at, (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') + interval '1 day') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS quota_reset_at FROM mt_crm_customer_pool_item_common i JOIN mt_crm_customer_pool_common p ON p.pid = i.crm_cpi_pool_id AND p.tenant_id = i.tenant_id JOIN ab_user current_actor ON current_actor.id = CAST(#{params.currentUserId} AS bigint) LEFT JOIN ab_user owner_user ON owner_user.pid = i.crm_cpi_claimed_by LEFT JOIN ab_user previous_user ON previous_user.pid = i.crm_cpi_previous_owner LEFT JOIN mt_crm_customer_pool_quota_common quota ON quota.tenant_id = i.tenant_id AND quota.crm_cpq_pool_id = i.crm_cpi_pool_id AND quota.crm_cpq_user_id = current_actor.pid AND quota.crm_cpq_local_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date LEFT JOIN mt_crm_customer_capacity_common capacity ON capacity.tenant_id = i.tenant_id AND capacity.crm_ccap_user_id = current_actor.pid AND capacity.crm_ccap_status = 'active' WHERE i.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND (p.crm_cp_member_user_ids LIKE CONCAT('%"', current_actor.pid, '"%') OR p.crm_cp_admin_user_ids LIKE CONCAT('%"', current_actor.pid, '"%'))) b) assessed) q WHERE (COALESCE(CAST(#{params.customerKeyword} AS text), '') = '' OR q.crm_cpi_account_code ILIKE CONCAT('%', CAST(#{params.customerKeyword} AS text), '%') OR q.crm_cpi_account_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', CAST(#{params.customerKeyword} AS text), '%') OR COALESCE(q.crm_cpi_phone, '') ILIKE CONCAT('%', CAST(#{params.customerKeyword} AS text), '%')) AND (COALESCE(CAST(#{params.viewFilter} AS text), '') = '' OR (CAST(#{params.viewFilter} AS text) = 'available' AND q.crm_cpi_status = 'available') OR (CAST(#{params.viewFilter} AS text) = 'ready' AND q.operational_state = 'ready') OR (CAST(#{params.viewFilter} AS text) = 'blocked' AND q.operational_state IN ('cooldown', 'quota_blocked', 'capacity_blocked')) OR (CAST(#{params.viewFilter} AS text) = 'cooldown' AND q.operational_state = 'cooldown') OR (CAST(#{params.viewFilter} AS text) = 'owned' AND q.crm_cpi_status IN ('claimed', 'assigned')) OR (CAST(#{params.viewFilter} AS text) = 'processing' AND q.crm_cpi_status IN ('recycling', 'recycling_retry'))) ORDER BY CASE q.operational_state WHEN 'ready' THEN 1 WHEN 'cooldown' THEN 2 WHEN 'quota_blocked' THEN 3 WHEN 'capacity_blocked' THEN 4 WHEN 'recycling_retry' THEN 5 WHEN 'recycling' THEN 6 WHEN 'assigned' THEN 7 ELSE 8 END, q.crm_cpi_health_score DESC NULLS LAST, q.crm_cpi_entered_at ASC

description: Administrator summary for enabled pools, claim capacity, automatic recycle and active recycle conditions.
fromSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.crm_cp_status = 'enabled') AS enabled_pool_count, COALESCE(SUM(p.crm_cp_daily_pick_limit) FILTER (WHERE p.crm_cp_status = 'enabled'), 0) AS daily_claim_capacity, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.crm_cp_status = 'enabled' AND p.crm_cp_auto_recycle = true) AS auto_recycle_pool_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mt_crm_customer_pool_recycle_rule_common r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND r.crm_cprr_status = 'active') AS active_recycle_rule_count FROM mt_crm_customer_pool_common p WHERE p.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}

description: Pool policies with business-safe membership counts and active recycle-condition counts.
fromSql: SELECT p.pid, p.crm_cp_code, p.crm_cp_name, p.crm_cp_status, COALESCE(CASE WHEN LEFT(TRIM(COALESCE(p.crm_cp_member_user_ids, '')), 1) = '[' THEN jsonb_array_length(p.crm_cp_member_user_ids::jsonb) ELSE cardinality(string_to_array(NULLIF(TRIM(p.crm_cp_member_user_ids), ''), ',')) END, 0) AS member_count, COALESCE(CASE WHEN LEFT(TRIM(COALESCE(p.crm_cp_admin_user_ids, '')), 1) = '[' THEN jsonb_array_length(p.crm_cp_admin_user_ids::jsonb) ELSE cardinality(string_to_array(NULLIF(TRIM(p.crm_cp_admin_user_ids), ''), ',')) END, 0) AS admin_count, p.crm_cp_daily_pick_limit, p.crm_cp_new_cooldown_days, p.crm_cp_previous_owner_cooldown_days, p.crm_cp_auto_recycle, p.crm_cp_recycle_match_mode, p.crm_cp_recycle_after_days, p.crm_cp_recycle_basis, p.crm_cp_description, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mt_crm_customer_pool_recycle_rule_common r WHERE r.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND r.crm_cprr_pool_id = p.pid AND r.crm_cprr_status = 'active') AS active_rule_count, p.updated_at FROM mt_crm_customer_pool_common p WHERE p.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND (COALESCE(CAST(#{params.policyKeyword} AS text), '') = '' OR p.crm_cp_code ILIKE CONCAT('%', CAST(#{params.policyKeyword} AS text), '%') OR p.crm_cp_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', CAST(#{params.policyKeyword} AS text), '%')) ORDER BY CASE p.crm_cp_status WHEN 'enabled' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, p.updated_at DESC

description: Customer capacity policies with user labels, current ownership and remaining capacity.
fromSql: SELECT c.pid, c.crm_ccap_user_id, COALESCE(u.nick_name, u.user_name, c.crm_ccap_user_id) AS user_name, c.crm_ccap_capacity, c.crm_ccap_status, c.crm_ccap_remark, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mt_crm_account_common a WHERE a.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND a.crm_acc_owner = c.crm_ccap_user_id AND a.crm_acc_status = 'active' AND COALESCE(a.crm_acc_pool_state, '') <> 'in_pool') AS owned_customer_count, GREATEST(c.crm_ccap_capacity - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mt_crm_account_common a WHERE a.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND a.crm_acc_owner = c.crm_ccap_user_id AND a.crm_acc_status = 'active' AND COALESCE(a.crm_acc_pool_state, '') <> 'in_pool'), 0) AS remaining_capacity FROM mt_crm_customer_capacity_common c LEFT JOIN ab_user u ON u.pid = c.crm_ccap_user_id WHERE c.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} ORDER BY CASE c.crm_ccap_status WHEN 'active' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, user_name ASC

name:zh-CN: 客户公海回收策略队列
description: Recycle conditions with resolved customer-pool business labels.
fromSql: SELECT r.pid, r.crm_cprr_code, r.crm_cprr_name, r.crm_cprr_pool_id, COALESCE(p.crm_cp_name, r.crm_cprr_pool_id) AS pool_name, r.crm_cprr_time_source, r.crm_cprr_operator, r.crm_cprr_days, r.crm_cprr_start_at, r.crm_cprr_end_at, r.crm_cprr_status, r.crm_cprr_sort_order, r.crm_cprr_description FROM mt_crm_customer_pool_recycle_rule_common r LEFT JOIN mt_crm_customer_pool_common p ON p.pid = r.crm_cprr_pool_id AND p.tenant_id = r.tenant_id WHERE r.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} ORDER BY CASE r.crm_cprr_status WHEN 'active' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, pool_name ASC, r.crm_cprr_sort_order ASC

description: Account, contact and opportunity activities for one exact pool item, restricted to current pool membership.
fromSql: SELECT DISTINCT a.pid, a.crm_act_type, a.crm_act_subject, a.crm_act_content, a.crm_act_date, a.crm_act_owner, a.crm_act_source, a.crm_act_ext->>'status' AS crm_act_status, COALESCE(r.crm_ar_object_type, CASE a.crm_act_related_model WHEN 'crm_account_common' THEN 'account' WHEN 'crm_contact_common' THEN 'contact' WHEN 'crm_opportunity_common' THEN 'opportunity' ELSE NULL END) AS crm_ar_object_type, r.crm_ar_role, COALESCE(u.nick_name, u.user_name, a.crm_act_owner, '') AS owner_name FROM mt_crm_customer_pool_item_common i JOIN mt_crm_customer_pool_common p ON p.pid = i.crm_cpi_pool_id AND p.tenant_id = i.tenant_id JOIN mt_crm_activity_common a ON a.tenant_id = i.tenant_id LEFT JOIN mt_crm_activity_relation_common r ON r.crm_ar_activity_id = a.pid AND r.tenant_id = i.tenant_id AND ((r.crm_ar_object_type = 'account' AND r.crm_ar_object_id = i.crm_cpi_account_id) OR (r.crm_ar_object_type = 'contact' AND r.crm_ar_object_id IN (SELECT c.pid FROM mt_crm_contact_common c WHERE c.tenant_id = i.tenant_id AND c.crm_ct_account_id = i.crm_cpi_account_id)) OR (r.crm_ar_object_type = 'opportunity' AND r.crm_ar_object_id IN (SELECT o.pid FROM
